Make your Dussehra celebrations extra sweet with 4 delicious Indian dessert recipes! From crispy, syrup-soaked Jalebi to rich Butterscotch Barfi, these festive treats bring something special to your celebrations.
In this video, discover four sweet recipes that are perfect for sharing with family and friends this Dussehra.
Jalebi – Crispy, golden spirals soaked in fragrant sugar syrup and served with creamy rabri.
Cabbage Kheer – A unique twist on the classic Indian dessert, made with milk, cardamom, charoli and nutmeg.
